label: Aggregated price feed ETH/USD from Chronicle, Chainlink, and RedStone oracles
reasons: R_lo ≥ 1.5, R_pt ≥ 10, C_lo ≥ $100M, no free-move EV
notes: redstone pull feed: free move = caller-chosen price within the staleness window (assumed 60s, vol 60%/yr)
Aave-family downside EV needs per-borrower health (not fetched); EV_pt downside withheld, see README gaps
pastAttackNote: Every measured past oracle attack had cost / extracted ≤ 0.76. R below 1.5 means the cheapest move is within that danger band.
scopeNote: v1 covers Ethereum mainnet only. The data is NOT exhaustive and will be extended (other chains, Euler/Fluid/Liquity readers, Membrane Cdp positions).
evScopeNote: EV scope = every mainnet market reading this leaf that the engine enumerates (Morpho, Aave v3, Spark, Compound III). Euler, Fluid and Liquity v2 readers are not yet included.
